decisive_items: superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
Periodic acid–Schiff (PAS) stain was negative for fungal organisms
response.rationale: The annular non-scaling eruption plus the eosinophil-rich perivascular/interstitial biopsy pattern and negative PAS stain best fit eosinophilic cellulitis. The immunotherapy-related options only reflect the temporal drug history and do not specify the distinctive tissue pathology; R1 and R2 share equivalent timing and are not separable from these data.

rejected.why: Temporal immunotherapy association is broad and does not distinguish ipilimumab from pembrolizumab; lacks the specific eosinophilic tissue diagnosis.
Same generic temporal support as R1 without a distinctive clinicopathologic pattern; not separable from the other immunotherapy-related option.
